stories.title: Dutch GP Sprint Weekend — 3 Days to Zandvoort, History on the Line

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
3 days to the final Dutch Grand Prix.

Zandvoort gets its first-ever Sprint format this weekend.

ONE practice session. Then Sprint Qualifying. Then the race.

No data. No margin for error. 85% chance of rain Sunday.

This will be chaos. Brilliant, beautiful chaos.

#DutchGP #F1

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Zandvoort farewell weekend:

📅 Fri Aug 21 — FP1 + Sprint Qualifying
📅 Sat Aug 22 — Sprint + Grand Prix Qualifying
📅 Sun Aug 23 — 72-lap Dutch GP (15:00 CEST)

First Sprint. Last Dutch GP. Verstappen's home crowd.

3 days. #DutchGP #F1
